acceptance.criterion: HTTP/1 and HTTP/2 pool admission is bounded, fair across owners, and retains caller timeout/cancellation semantics.
acceptance.evidence: Both native suites pass admission rotation, waiter-capacity, cancellation cleanup, and absolute-deadline cases: Http1ConnectionPoolTest.admissionRotatesOriginsAndYieldsTheFullPoolSlot; Http2ConnectionPoolTest.admissionRotatesOriginsAndYieldsAFullHttp2PoolSlot; Http1ConnectionPoolTest.activeWaitHonorsCancellationAndReleasesWaiterSlot; Http2ConnectionPoolTest.fullBoundedPoolHonorsOneCallerDeadline.

acceptance.criterion: Expired or unhealthy pool connections are evicted without premature termination of active HTTP/2 streams.
acceptance.evidence: Native tests pass idle and leased HTTP/1 lifetime eviction and active HTTP/2 drain-before-close/replacement: Http1ConnectionPoolTest.expiresConnectionsAtMaximumLifetime; Http1ConnectionPoolTest.evictsLeasedConnectionAtMaximumLifetimeOnRelease; Http2ConnectionPoolTest.expiresConnectionsAtMaximumLifetime; Http2ConnectionPoolTest.drainsExpiredHttp2ConnectionAfterActiveStreamCompletion.

acceptance.criterion: Response-body cleanup is bounded and preserves protocol-specific ownership.
acceptance.evidence: HTTP/1 early close closes instead of reusing its connection; HTTP/2 early close resets only its local stream and remains usable; peer RST and GOAWAY retain their separate stream/connection semantics.

acceptance.criterion: Automatic retries require structured pre-submission or request-commit evidence plus replay and method safety.
acceptance.evidence: HttpRetryPolicyTest.retryRequiresPhaseOrSubmissionEvidence and HttpRetryPolicyTest.goAwayRetriesOnlyDefinitelyUnprocessedSafeReplayableRequests pass. Http1ClientConnectionTest.responseFailureCarriesCommittedRequestEvidence verifies committed request bytes; Http1ClientConnectionTest.executionFailurePreservesNetworkErrorEvidence verifies category, phase, code, retryability, native code, endpoints, cause, and immutable write evidence are retained.

acceptance.criterion: Retry attempts retain the original operation budget and cleanup remains exact-once.
acceptance.evidence: Native tests pass continueWaitTimeoutSendsBodyUnderTheOriginalBudget, timeoutAndCancellationRaceAbandonsBodyExactlyOnce, poolCloseAbortsEverySharedConnectionExactlyOnce, and the H2 stream-close/drain cases.
